characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Third Age
characters.summary: Durin's Bane is a Balrog of Morgoth residing in the depths of Moria. It is a towering demon of shadow and flame wielding a fiery whip and a heavy sword.

techniques: Aura of intense heat and shadow

weaknesses: Magical strikes and blows from empowered entities like Gandalf
limitations: Bound to dark subterranean domains and physical manifestation limits

sources.supports: Abilities, weapons, physical description, and history in Moria.

feats.claim: Drove the Dwarves from Khazad-dûm and killed King Durin VI
Fought Gandalf the Grey through the depths and peak of Zirakzigil before perishing
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring / The Two Towers

notableResults.note: Killed after a prolonged duel on Zirakzigil

campaignTags.claim: Emits an aura of fire and wields a fiery whip
Wields a fiery whip and sword
Stands significantly taller than a normal man with a shadow of great wings

unknowns: Whether Balrogs possessed literal functional wings of flight.

characters.summary: Dwalin is a hardy Dwarf of Thorin's Company, equipped with heavy armor, an axe, and a hammer. He relies on steadfast endurance and brutal close-quarters melee combat.
weaknesses: Limited mobility against ranged or agile foes

sources.supports: Weapons, armor, and role in Thorin's Company.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Five Armies and survived into the Fourth Age

characters.summary: Eärendil the Mariner sailed the skies in his flying ship Vingilot, bearing the Silmaril. He successfully besought the Valor and defeated Ancalagon the Black in aerial combat.

mechanisms: Blinding stellar light of the Silmaril

limitations: Dependent on his ship and the Silmaril for stellar flight

sources.supports: Vingilot, the Silmaril, and the War of Wrath feats.

feats.claim: Slew the great dragon Ancalagon the Black during the War of Wrath
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Voyage of Eärendil and the War of Wrath

notableResults.note: Fought in the skies above Thangorodrim with eagles

campaignTags.claim: Navigates the skies aboard the flying ship Vingilot
Wields the Silmaril upon his brow and ship
Pilots the celestial flying vessel Vingilot

unknowns: Exact mechanics of Vingilot's flight through space.

characters.continuity: The Fall of Gondolin / Third Age
characters.summary: Ecthelion was a Lord of Gondolin and captain of the King's Guard. He fought with elven blade and spiked helm, famously destroying Gothmog Lord of Balrogs at the cost of his own life.
weaknesses: Mortal/physical vulnerability to extreme heat and demonic force
limitations: Standard physical limits of Eldar in physical combat

sources.supports: Role in Gondolin, weapons, and duel with Gothmog.

feats.claim: Killed Gothmog, Lord of Balrogs, by driving his spiked helm into him and dragging him into a fountain

notableResults.note: Mutual kill; both perished in the fountain

unknowns: Details of his combat abilities outside the defense of Gondolin.

characters.summary: Elendil the Tall was the High King of Arnor and Gondor, wielding the sword Narsil. He possessed immense stature and martial might, fighting in the Last Alliance of Men and Elves.

mechanisms: Exceptional height and physical endurance of the Númenórean Dunedain

limitations: Subject to mortal lifespan and injury

sources.supports: Status as High King, Narsil, and death on the slopes of Orodruin.

feats.claim: Fought Sauron directly at the siege of Barad-dûr before perishing
feats.citation: The Fellowship of the Ring / The Silmarillion

notableResults.note: Slain in combat alongside Gil-galad, though Sauron was also overthrown

campaignTags.claim: Stood nearly eight feet tall as a high-man of Númenor

unknowns: Exact duration and blows exchanged in his duel with Sauron.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Third Age
characters.summary: Elrond is the Lord of Rivendell, a master healer, ring-bearer, and ancient elf-lord. He wields the elven ring Vilya and commands powerful protective magic and environmental control.

techniques: Summoning river floods and protective wards

weaknesses: Vulnerability to physical overwhelming if magical defenses fail
limitations: Magical displays often tied to prepared terrain or environmental features

sources.supports: Possession of Vilya, healing skills, mastery of Rivendell, and sword Hadhafang.

feats.claim: Commanded the flood of the Bruinen to overwhelm the Ringwraiths
Fought in the Last Alliance of Men and Elves

notableResults.note: Swept them away using river magic

conditional.dependsOn: Proximity to the Bruinen river in Rivendell

campaignTags.claim: Renowned healer capable of curing grave wounds like Frodo's Morgul-knife injury
Bears Vilya, the Ring of Air
Raised the Bruinen river to sweep away Nazgûl

unknowns: Full offensive capabilities of Vilya in direct combat.

characters.summary: Elwing was the keeper of the Silmaril at the Havens of Sirion. Threatened by the sons of Fëanor, she cast herself into the sea and was transformed into a white bird by Ulmo.

techniques: Flight in avian form bearing the Silmaril

limitations: Lacks offensive combat training or martial prowess

sources.supports: Possession of the Silmaril, leap into the sea, and transformation into a bird.

feats.claim: Fled the destruction of the Havens of Sirion by leaping into the sea with the Silmaril and flying to Eärendil
feats.citation: The Silmarillion, Of the Voyage of Eärendil and the War of Wrath

campaignTags.claim: Transformed into a white bird capable of flying across the sea

unknowns: Combat application of the Silmaril outside its radiant deterrence.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Third Age
characters.summary: Éomer is a Marshal of the Riddermark and later King of Rohan. He fights fiercely on horseback with spear and sword, leading cavalry charges with devastating impact.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when unhorsed or swarmed by superior numbers

sources.supports: Weapons (Guthwinë), status as Marshal of the Riddermark, and mounted combat feats.

feats.claim: Slaughtered the band of Uruk-hai holding Merry and Pippin near Fangorn
Fought at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields and the Battle of the Morannon

notableResults.note: Annihilated the raiders with his éored

conditional.ability: Enhanced tactical mobility and shock charge

campaignTags.claim: Fights effectively while mounted on his warhorse Firefoot

unknowns: Performance against high-tier supernatural entities without cavalry support.

characters.continuity: The Lord of the Rings / Third Age
characters.summary: Éowyn is the Shieldmaiden of Rohan who famously slew the Witch-king of Angmar. She combines fierce determination with sword and shield combat.
limitations: Physical stamina and injuries sustained from dark aura

sources.supports: Role as Shieldmaiden of Rohan and victory over the Witch-king.

feats.claim: Slew the Witch-king of Angmar at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields with Merry's help

notableResults.note: With Merry's assistance, destroyed the Nazgûl leader

conditional.ability: Ability to bypass the Witch-king's death-prophecy protection
conditional.dependsOn: Being a woman, aided by Merry's Barrow-blade

unknowns: Combat proficiency against standard heavyweight monsters without tactical advantage.
